About This Game

SPECIAL FORCE REMASTERED

Once again, we are Special Force.

The classic team-based FPS known for fast movement and precise gunplay returns to a new battlefield.

Special Force Remastered carries forward the fast-paced combat and distinctive gameplay flow of the original, reborn with modern visuals and new combat systems.

Step onto the battlefield as a special forces operative, and secure victory through quick decisions, precise control, and teamwork.

 

IT’S NOT OLD. IT’S CLASSIC.

Classic combat is classic for a reason.

The better you know the map, the more ways you can approach each firefight.

Precise movement. Split-second shot timing.

The tension of combat, where a single quick decision can turn the tide.

Special Force Remastered preserves the fast, intuitive combat feel and gameplay flow that defined the original.

Easy to pick up, but with greater depth to discover as your skills grow.

 

CHOOSE YOUR BATTLE

Experience the battlefield your way.

From fast-paced firefights focused on eliminating the enemy to tactical battles where teams work together to complete objectives, each mode offers a different way to fight.

TEAM MISSION

Bomb · Capture · Escape

Attack or defend as you complete objectives or eliminate the opposing team.

TEAM DEATHMATCH

Work with your team, take down more enemies, and claim victory.

FREE FOR ALL

Prove your skill on a battlefield where every other player is an enemy.

SNIPER

Decide the battle with one precise shot and split-second judgment.

 

CHANGE THE BATTLE

New choices that can change the course of battle.

Not every battle is decided by gunfire alone.

Use drones to locate enemies or engage them directly, and break through fortified defenses with the RPG-7.

Deploy tactical equipment suited to the situation, including reconnaissance support and healing injectors, to seize the initiative for your team.

One choice can change the course of battle.

 

BUILD YOUR WEAPON

Build a weapon that fits the way you fight.

Level up your weapons through combat and unlock a variety of weapon parts.

Combine sights, muzzles, stocks, and other parts to build a weapon tailored to your playstyle.

Even the same weapon can take on different characteristics and roles depending on the parts you choose.

 

PROVE YOUR SKILL

Let your skill speak for itself.

Keep winning and challenge yourself to climb higher.

With a skill-based tier system and refined matchmaking, you can compete against players of similar skill and push your limits.

Fight through each season, claim victory, and rise to higher tiers.

At the highest level of competition, prove that you have what it takes to be Special Force.

 

YOUR BATTLE. YOUR STYLE.

You decide how you look on the battlefield.

Express your individuality on the battlefield with a variety of customization options, including characters and weapon skins.

The outcome of battle is determined by your skill, not by what you buy.

Customize your style freely, and compete through skill, teamwork, and tactical judgment.

 

WE ARE SPECIAL FORCE.

Ths Classic fell of combat.

New tactics. New competition.

And Special Force begins again.

Join the new battlefield now.

SPECIAL FORCE REMASTERED
